Remark
[Independence from initial derivative bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0263, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0264 ↗ thm:chow-ii-shi-local-first-derivative-estimate 1. ch14:14.11\group Local Curvature Estimates

The estimate requires no bound on $|\nabla \operatorname {Rm}(g(0))|$. It is enough that each smaller closed initial ball be compact; the flow need not be complete outside the neighborhood on which the curvature bound is assumed.
